description: The configured note directory has been renamed away; what remains beside it is under a name nothing is configured to read. The handshake still succeeds, because the configuration is valid and nothing has been asked of the source yet. The search then fails with source_unavailable (-32000) rather than returning zero candidates, which is the invariant this case exists to hold: a source that cannot be reached must never be indistinguishable from one with no matches. Health reports unavailable with unknown coverage, and the diagnostic names the directory by base name only.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
